note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; jurisdiction unspecified. Only the focus tag's reference is substituted; its line follows the row carrying that reference, or is not redrawn when none does (as supplied). No validity, responsibility or outcome is inferred. Editable brief fields: items, custodians, timestamps, records, focusTarget, beforeValue, afterValue, detailGeometry, contextLabels (+ focusItem). Coordinator decision 2026-10-06 (evidence-custody-05 iteration 2): the long-labels-stress entry references are shortened to "Entry 26-0x" (still longer than the baseline references) so the cell tags can carry them. Coordinator decision 2026-10-06 (evidence-custody-05 iteration 3, standing stress-cap rule): the long-labels-stress preset is capped at 3 objects / 3 list rows (equal to the baseline count); every text stays longer than its baseline counterpart.
